name: Warner Bros. Discovery
tagline: A leading global media and entertainment company that creates and distributes a differentiated and comprehensive portfolio of content and products across television, film, streaming, interactive gaming, publishing, themed experiences, and consumer products
hero_kpi_rationale: Le revenu publicitaire est le levier le plus suivi de WBD : il agrège l'audience des chaînes linéaires et la montée des abonnés HBO Max ad-lite, avec 5 ans d'historique annuel verbatim au 10-K.

kpis.signal: Croissance continue portée par l'expansion internationale de HBO Max, au-dessus de 140 millions.

ai_positioning.summary: La société WBD ne mentionne pas l'intelligence artificielle (IA) ou l'apprentissage automatique dans son rapport 10-K/20-F.

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks including attacks on its systems and data. While cybersecurity is important, language in the filing is standard for media companies with digital platforms.
risks.summary: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks that could impact its operations and reputation.

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company is involved in legal proceedings, but no specific material litigation mentioned in the filing demonstrates elevated risk beyond typical industry exposure.
risks.summary: The company is subject to litigation that could impact its operations and reputation.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to standard regulations common to media and entertainment companies operating globally, including data protection and cybersecurity requirements.
risks.summary: The company is subject to regulations that could impact its operations and reputation.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in an intensely competitive environment across streaming, linear television, and film production, with significant competitive pressures from major tech and entertainment competitors.
risks.summary: The company operates in a highly competitive environment that could impact its market share and revenues.

risks.title: Multiemployer Pension Plans
risks.score_rationale: The company participates in multiemployer defined benefit pension plans, which could subject it to liabilities if plans become underfunded or if the company withdraws participation.
risks.summary: The company's participation in multiemployer pension plans could result in liabilities affecting costs and cash flows.

risks.title: Linear Television Decline
risks.score_rationale: Structural decline in linear television viewership (25% audience decline in domestic networks in 2025) and subscribers (9% decline) represents a fundamental shift in consumer behavior away from traditional television.
risks.summary: Ongoing structural decline in linear television represents a significant challenge to traditional revenue streams and business model.

risks.title: Geopolitics
risks.score_rationale: The company operates globally and is exposed to geopolitical risks, but no specific material geopolitical issues are highlighted in the filing.
risks.summary: The company operates in a complex geopolitical environment that could impact its operations and reputation.

risks.title: Technology
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to technology risks including streaming platform reliability and digital content distribution, but these are managed through standard operational practices.
risks.summary: The company is exposed to technology risks related to streaming platforms and digital content delivery.

_validation.corrections_summary: Comprehensive audit of KPI dataset revealed multiple critical errors requiring correction

kpi_corrections.issue: Value '13' is hallucinated - source shows 131.6 million total streaming subscribers (59.2M domestic + 72.4M international)
kpi_corrections.correction: Changed value to '131.6', unit to 'M' (millions not billions)

kpi_corrections.issue: Unit 'Mds $' is incorrect French abbreviation for billions
kpi_corrections.correction: Changed all units from 'Mds $' to 'B $' for consistency with financial reporting standard

kpi_corrections.issue: yoy 'stable' is meaningless when moving from -10.032B loss to +0.738B profit
kpi_corrections.correction: Changed yoy to 'N/A' as comparison is not meaningful

kpi_corrections.issue: Value '9' is hallucinated - represents year-over-year decline percentage, not actual subscriber count
kpi_corrections.correction: Changed value to '59.2' (actual domestic subscribers from source), unit to 'M', history updated to reflect 65.2M prior year

kpi_corrections.issue: ttm values were inconsistent with actual data points
kpi_corrections.correction: Updated all ttm values to match most recent period value

kpi_corrections.issue: Risk severity scores and categories were not grounded in source material
kpi_corrections.correction: Recalibrated severity scores based on actual risk disclosures in 10-K, elevated 'Concurrence' to 3 and 'Linear Television Decline' to 4, reduced 'Litiges' to 2

data_quality_issues: Value hallucinations: Streaming Subscribers (13 vs 131.6M), Domestic Linear Subscribers (9 vs 59.2M)
Unit confusion: 'Mds' (French billions) inconsistently used instead of 'B $' for revenue figures
Ratio vs absolute confusion: Domestic Linear Subscribers history uses decline percentage instead of actual count
YoY labels incorrect: Operating Income 'stable' when actually transitioning from large loss to small profit
_validation.source_alignment: All corrected values verified against provided 10-K MD&A and Financial Statements sections showing FY2025 vs FY2024 comparisons

company_description: Warner Bros. Discovery, Inc. operates as a media and entertainment company worldwide. It operates through three segments: Streaming, Studios, and Global Linear Networks. The Streaming segment offers streaming services, such as HBO Max and discovery+, and premium pay-TV services, including HBO and certain premium sports streaming products for mobile and connected TV devices. The Studios segment is involved in the production and release of feature films for initial exhibition in theaters, production and initial licensing of television programs to third parties and its networks/streaming services. This segment also distributes films and television programs to various third-party and internal television, streaming services, and physical and digital home entertainment markets; related consumer products and themed experience licensing; and publishes, develops, licenses, and distributes content for the interactive space in platforms, including console, handheld, mobile, and PC-based gaming for both internal and third-party game titles.
